q: The measure of maximal entropy (MME) for a hyperbolic set Λ of a C¹⁺α diffeomorphism equals the SRB measure if and only if:
opts: The Lyapunov exponents are all equal
The system is volume-preserving and ergodic w.r.t. volume
The stable and unstable manifolds have equal dimension
The topological entropy equals the sum of all positive Lyapunov exponents for every invariant measure
exp: MME = SRB iff the system preserves a smooth (absolutely continuous) measure, i.e., it is volume-preserving (the Jacobian det(DT) = 1 along unstable manifolds). For Anosov diffeomorphisms, this is equivalent to volume preservation.
